Our Story.

Our Story.

"Anyone can be a plant parent!"

When the idea of Ugaoo came to me in 2014, I believed that more people would fall in love with gardening if it felt simpler, more accessible, and less intimidating. Growing plants has always been a part of who we are, rooted in our homes, our traditions, our everyday lives. But for many, getting started wasn't easy. Ugaoo was created to change that. To make gardening easy and inviting for everyone, whether you're bringing home your very first plant or nurturing a lifelong passion.

Because that special connection to nature, once you feel it, never really leaves you.

Welcome to Ugaoo, your one stop gardening shop! 🍃
